question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Retard
solution:
The correct answer is option 1) i.e. 'Hurry.'

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let's look at the meanings of the given word and marked option:

 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 Retard
 to make something slower
 
 

 Hurry
 to move or do things more quickly than normal or to make someone do this.
 
 
 
 
 
• ​Let's look at the meanings of the other given options:
 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 Choke
 to make someone stop breathing by pressing their throat with their hands.
 
 

 Delay
 to make something happen at a later time than originally planned or expected.
 
 

 Cram
 to force a lot of things into a small space; to do many things in a short period of time.
 
 
 
 

 

 
• Hence from the given meanings, we find that 'Retard' and 'Hurry' are antonyms.
 
• So, the correct answer is option 1.​​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Let's look at the synonyms and antonyms for the given word 'Retard':

 
• Synonyms: choke off, crimp, decelerate, hamper, handicap, impede.
 
• Antonyms: aid, assist, help, promote, advance, allow.
